title: App Store & Google Play Scraper: Keyword Ranks, Charts, Details
description: Apple App Store and Google Play app data in one schema: App Store keyword search ranks (ASO), top free/paid/grossing charts by country and category, and app details by URL or ID (rating, installs, price, version). Rank-change alerts. $1 per 1,000 rank rows, $1.50 per 1,000 apps.
